Tooltip_AHS_Item_AdvancedMedicalKit: Nine-use advanced medical kit. Treats wounds and restores 35 general health when used.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_AntiInflammatory: Reduces inflammatory pressure, pain, and muscle strain. It immediately lowers body-part stiffness and continues easing it while active.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Antibiotics: Helps lower bacterial load gradually and supports infection resolution.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_BetaBlockers: Cuts stress and panic load, helping stabilize anxious episodes.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Defibrillator: Three-charge resuscitation tool for critical cardiac arrest. It can drop the episode from critical to severe; using it outside that case causes shock, pain, and stress.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_ElectrolyteDrink: Restores hydration support and helps stabilize digestive or dehydration episodes.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_EpinephrineBlocked: Can only be injected during an active critical cardiac arrest.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_EpinephrineInjection: Emergency injection for critical cardiac arrest. Reduces exhaustion and fatigue, but spikes pulse, blood pressure, stress, panic, and sweating. Cannot be repeated quickly.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_FlexibleSplint: Advanced flexible splint for fractures. It provides the strongest recovery bonus of the AHS splints.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_MedicalKit: Three-use medical kit. Treats wounds and restores 20 general health when used.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_MedicalThermometer: Diagnostic tool for checking body temperature during self-examination.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Nebulizer: Five-treatment device that reduces cardiac, panic, and stress load during an active tachycardia episode.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_NebulizerBlocked: Can only be used during an active tachycardia episode.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Painkiller: Blunts pain load and, during matching illness episodes, gently eases fever over time; it does not fix the cause.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_PulseOximeter: Shows oxygenation and pulse from the item context menu.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_RusticTourniquet: Basic limb tourniquet. It lasts less than a medical tourniquet.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_SkinStapler: Five-charge wound-closure tool. Requires First Aid level 1 and closes deep wounds that contain no glass.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_SleepingTablets: A fast-acting stimulant that cuts fatigue and boosts endurance for a few hours, but can leave you tense.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Sphygmomanometer: Diagnostic tool for checking pressure and pulse during an examination.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Splint: Medical splint for fractures. Its splint factor is always higher than the vanilla splint, shortening recovery time.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_SteriStrip: Temporarily closes a deep wound and stops bleeding until it heals or is removed for stitching.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Stethoscope: Diagnostic tool. With the sphygmomanometer, pulse oximeter, and thermometer, it reduces self-exam time.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Tourniquet: Emergency tourniquet for limbs. Controls bleeding temporarily.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_TourniquetCat: Emergency tourniquet for limbs. Controls bleeding for the longest time.

Tooltip_Anchor: Gain immunity from being knocked down by gravity anomalies, but lose some carry weight. Gives off faint radiation.
Tooltip_Bubble: Purges radiation and illness from your body, but it makes you quite thirsty and gives off faint radiation.
Tooltip_DeadStar: Gravity anomalies ignore you, completely. Theres no con to this, but you better use it quick, the radiation melts your skin.
Tooltip_Ember: Frost Zone damage is halved, and it warms you up. Makes you thirsty and a bit tired. Gives off moderate radiation.
Tooltip_Featherweight: Get 6 more carry weight, but you gain fatigue over time. Gives off moderate radiation.
Tooltip_Hoarfrost: Damage taken in Thermal Zones is halved, and it cools you down, but sometimes a bit too much. Gives off faint radiation.
Tooltip_LeadCase: The Lead Case provides protection from most artifacts radiation and allows you to still use it.
Tooltip_Salamander: Gain passive health regen, but gain stress over time. Gives off alot of radiation.

Tooltip_Inventions_Costumes_desc: A garment or accessory that favors appearance over function, which is the entire point.
Tooltip_Inventions_Curios_desc: A peculiar creation that might serve a singular purpose or act as proof of concept for an idea, assuming it does not explode. Usually the first step toward something better.
Tooltip_Inventions_DemonCore_desc: A compact sphere of glowing potential, this incredible replica is positively charged with countless FUN! Just be careful... too much exposure may leave you feeling a little too hot.
Tooltip_Inventions_DrinkingBuddy_desc: A cute little toy or the physical manifestation of a sisyphean nightmare? How does it move on its own? Is there liquid in the can? Why must it drink? Our brave buddy has no time for answers as it is nearly time for another sip.
Tooltip_Inventions_FoodSynthesizer_desc: A cutting-edge culinary reprocessor that breaks down food items into an unsettling pink nutrient-rich paste. Technically edible and packed with all the essentials, it will never go bad and not even insects go near it for some reason, but its revolting flavor and texture don't make it very appealing to one's taste buds.
Tooltip_Inventions_Gadgets_desc: A device of promising utility, provided it survives testing and the occasional user error.
Tooltip_Inventions_Gramophone_desc: A mechanical audio device that plays music with surprising clarity, while sporting the fashionable look of an old style brass gramophone without any of its shortcomings.
Tooltip_Inventions_Harvester_desc: A state-of-the-art automated harvester equipped with rotating blades, suction ports, and questionable safety measures. Collects crops and seeds with impressive efficiency, but is prone to overheating.
Tooltip_Inventions_Hygienator_desc: This floor contraption triggers strategically placed water jets to wash any unsuspecting passerby in clean(-ish) water and soap. Results may vary.
Tooltip_Inventions_NeuralHat_desc: A large cap lined with neural interface needles that tap directly into your cerebral cortex, using low-voltage neural induction to boost cognitive processing. Prolonged use may cause mild dependency, nosebleeds, existential dread, and an inexplicable urge to reorganize socks by color.
Tooltip_Inventions_NextPage: Click the 'Stats' option to cycle between pages: <LINE><RGB:0.8,0.8,0.8> Next page: <SPACE><ORANGE>
Tooltip_Inventions_PowerAxe_desc: The latest development in tree-chopping technology, this heavily modified axe features a compact motor and an ultra-safe trigger that activates on impact with anything tree-like, delivering a small localized explosion that is sure to blast away branches, trunks, roots and maybe a finger or two.
Tooltip_Inventions_Ready: Gadget is ready to be used
Tooltip_Inventions_Refuel2: Breakdown of fuel stats, costs and related improvements
Tooltip_Inventions_ScrapBushSeed_desc: A remarkable large synthetic seed assembled from various scrap metal parts and assorted components. Defy all logic and current understanding of botany by planting it in soil and, with enough patience and a pinch of insanity, it may grow into a fully functional plant.
Tooltip_Inventions_Stats2: info, improvements present in this gadget and effects
Tooltip_Inventions_ToothpasteCurio_desc: Brush your teeth with this marvelous gift of science and wash away even the most stubborn food cravings! How does it work? Can it really cause uncontrollable rage? Why are my gums bleeding? Only YOU know the answers.
Tooltip_Inventions_Toys_desc: An item with little practical value beyond amusement, distraction and the satisfaction of having made it.
Tooltip_Inventions_UmbrellaHat_desc: A hands-free rain protection system that keeps the user mostly dry and in (theoretical) great style!

Tooltip_Sculpting_A_Hedge: The humble block of hedge... it's not just for trimming! Easy to work with, this verdant cube of leafy potential is the perfect canvas for creative minds and green thumbs alike. Watch as your artistry blossoms into leafy masterpieces. Who knew a simple hedge could be this cultivating?
Tooltip_Sculpting_A_Ice: Cool to the touch and fleetingly fragile, this block of ice is a blank slate for your artistic ambitions. Perfect for those with an eye for detail and a flair for the dramatic, each chip and carve reveals an ephemeral masterpiece. Beauty like this is bound to melt away!
Tooltip_Sculpting_A_Metal: Heavy, unyielding, and brimming with potential, this block of metal is the ultimate test for artists with a vision (and a strong arm). Channel your inner artisan and strike while the inspiration is hot! With this hunk of metal, you can turn dull scrap into refined brilliance. Just don’t forget the welding mask!
Tooltip_Sculpting_A_Stone: Timeless, steadfast, and ready to be transformed, this block of stone is the perfect medium for those with an artistic spark. Whether it's sleek marble or rugged granite, every sculpture begins with a bold first chisel. Patience and precision will turn this solid block into a masterpiece for the ages. Just watch out for flying chips!
Tooltip_Sculpting_A_Wood: This sturdy block of wood is ready to meet its destiny: transformation into a wooden wonder! Perfect for aspiring artists and handy carpenters, it’s more than just lumber; it’s potential waiting to be unleashed. Whether you’re crafting a rustic masterpiece or a fine work of art. Remember: every masterpiece starts with a single plank!

Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures2_24: Cool, captivating, and carved to perfection, this icy mermaid knows how to make a splash! With shimmering scales and a frosty allure, it brings oceanic elegance to your space. But don't get too attached! Her beauty is as fleeting as the tides on a sunny day. Perfect for adding a touch of mythic magic at winter parties.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures2_25: Sharp, sleek, and cooler than the deep blue sea, this icy art piece captures the majesty of a swordfish mid-leap. Perfectly carved from a solid block of ice, it brings a splash of oceanic drama to any event. This frosty marvel is sure to make waves!
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures2_31: Majestic, mythical, and chill in every sense, this sentry stands ready to protect your realm. Expertly sculpted from glistening ice, this frosty beast combines the strength of a lion and the elegance of an eagle for a look that's both fierce and fabulous. Perfect for adding a touch of legend to your place.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures2_32: Hot design meets ice-cold execution in this avant-garde masterpiece! This flaming piece reimagines the fiery flicker with sleek, frosty elegance, proving that opposites really do attract. Perfect for modern art lovers who want to keep their style cool while turning up the heat on their decor.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures2_34: Is it the real thing or just a chill work of art? The artwork captures the icy essence of the elusive snow-bound legend, standing still as if caught mid-roar (or mid-nap). Carved from a solid block of ice, this frosty friend is perfect for adding a touch of cool creature feature to their space. Be quick, though - this yeti doesn't do well in warm weather.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures2_36: Glide into elegance with this graceful art piece, an icy sculpture that's as cool as it is classic. Perfectly poised and delicately detailed, this frosty fowl brings a splash of sophistication to any setting. Whether it's gracing your living room or floating in your winter wonderland, this swan is guaranteed to make waves. Just don't let it ruffle your feathers when it melts.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures2_38: Purr-fection in frozen form! Icy Kitty captures the cool confidence of a feline friend perched atop its icy domain. With a frosty stare and a tail that's as sharp as its attitude, this sculpture is the cat's meow for anyone looking to add some chill vibes to their decor.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures2_40: Whimsical, winged, and wonderfully cool, this fairy flutters into your decor with an air of icy enchantment. Delicately sculpted to capture every frosty detail, this magical masterpiece is perfect for those who believe in fairytales - or just really love ice art.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures2_42: Magical and majestic, the unicorn rears up to bring a frosty fairytale vibe to your space. With its shimmering horn and crystalline mane, this enchanting sculpture is a must-have for anyone wanting to keep their decor cool and their dreams wild. Perfect for winter balls, or just turning your yard into a mystical wonderland, this piece is sure to melt into legend!
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures2_44: Who says dragons have to breathe fire? The Chillfire Dragon perches atop its frosty peak, exuding icy majesty and a touch of mythical charm. With gleaming scales and frozen wings, this frosty beast is the ultimate showstopper for any daring decor.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_0: The face that launched a thousand ships, this artwork is a marble masterpiece of timeless beauty. Sculpted with breathtaking detail, this stunning statue brings classical elegance and mythological drama to any space. Perfect for those who want their homes to be as legendary as Helen herself.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_1: Take your decor back to the days of pharaohs and pyramids with this timeless tomb! The Sarcophagus is expertly carved from solid stone, featuring regal egyptian flair. This piece will make your home the burial ground for boring design.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_2: The Thinker is the perfect piece for those who enjoy pondering life's great mysteries. With its timeless pose and impeccable craftsmanship, this statue adds a touch of intellectual sophistication to any space. Perfect for that one corner that just feels philosophically empty.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_3: Regal, fearless, and completely immobile - this marble lion commands attention from anyone who dares enter your domain. Whether guarding your garden path or lounging in living room, its chiselled mane and piercing gaze make it clear who's king.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_32: Who says dinosaurs are extinct? This pint-sized T-rex, cobbled together from rusty scrap metal, has roared back to life (sort of). Its jagged teeth and spindly claws makes it a fearsome and trusty companion in the post-apocalypse.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_4: Marble meets musings in this timeless tribute to deep thought. Featuring a classical philosopher mid-ponder, this sculpture invites questions like: 'what is the meaning of life?' and 'does this look better in the study or the courtyard?' Whether you're cultivating a space of wisdom or just want to show off your highbrow taste, this piece adds a dash of intellectual flair.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_41: With exposed gears and an assortment of rusty pipes and scrap, this pendulum clock is the perfect blend of funcionality and industrial flair.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_46: Who says flowers need water and sunshine? This mechanical sunflower thrives on nothing but creativity and a little rust. Standing tall with petals made of salvaged plates and stems of twisted metal, it's part industrial art, part homage to nature. Whether brightening a workshop or sprucing up a gritty garden, this bloom is built to last.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_5: An artifact of questionable origin but undeniable charm, this 'ancient' urn brings a whisper of history to any room. Was it a treasure of a long-lost civilization or just the result of a particularly inspired sculptor? Who knows! (except for you). What's certain is its ability to elevate any space with its intricate carvings and mysterious aura.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_51: Step right up and meet this fortune-telling contraption that's as mysterious as it is... inaccurate. Built from salvaged gears and questionable wiring, this clunky automaton will peer deep into its predictive circuits and offer you a future that's totally random but oddly satisfying. Feeling lucky? Nervous? Skeptical? No matter, this machine doesn’t care! It's all about the mood swings it inspires.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_57: A horse that won't gallop but still steals the show, this towering metal steed rears back in dramatic defiance. Pieced together from cogs, pipes, and a generous helping of rust, it's a bold blend of industrial grit and equestrian grace.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_6: Step right up and behold the entire planet: marbleized, pedestalized, and slightly improvized! This globe isn't exactly geographically accurate (sorry, cartographers), but who needs precision when you have style? With its smooth curves and timeless craftsmanship, it's a conversation piece for explorers, dreamers and mad geniuses alike.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_62: This oversized wooden squirrel is the ultimate guardian of... whatever you deem nut-worthy. With its charmingly exaggerated paws clutching an enormous acorn, it's as if the forest decided to try its hand at sculpture. Whimsical yet sturdy, this piece is ideal for sprucing up your yard.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures3_7: Looming and unyielding, this marble gargoyle is perfect for keeping unwanted visitors at bay. Standing tall on its hind legs, it looks ready to swoop down or deliver a dramatic monologue. Is it art? Is it a protector? Maybe both. Either way, its menacing charm will leave you impressed... or slightly uneasy.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures4_11: This carving captures a tender moment between two wolves, their carved forms intertwined in a display of loyalty and love. Whether they're sharing secrets of the wild or just enjoying the moonlight together, their warmth radiates despite their wooden forms. No matter if you're a lone wolf or part of a pack, this piece speaks to the soul.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures4_14: This towering wooden bear isn't here to growl or scare, it's all about quiet strength and a stoic vibe. With clean, minimalist shapes and a no-nonsense stance, it brings a modern forest charm that says: 'I'm here, I'm bear, get used to it'.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures4_19: This leafy penguin is here to bring a chill vibe to your garden, without the ice. Carefully trimmed to adorable perfection, it’s the perfect combination of charm and greenery. Whether it's leading a hedge parade or just standing around looking dapper, this topiary buddy guarantees your landscaping will never look penguin-sive again.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures4_2: Capture the quiet power of the forest with this minimalist wooden elk sculpture. Its clean lines and blocky elegance hint at nature without fuss, creating a perfect balance of strength and simplicity.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures4_25: Transform your garden into a haven of zen with this lush hedge panda, perfectly pruned to radiate charm. Its rounded shapes and playful posture make it an instant favorite for anyone who loves nature (or just really likes pandas).
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures4_32: Who says dragons have to be fierce? This adorable baby dragon topiary trades fire for foliage, adding a splash of mythical charm to your garden. With its stubby wings and playful pose, it looks like it's ready to take its first flight, or maybe just snooze in the sun.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures4_38: Who needs a racing trophy when you can celebrate life in the slow lane? This charming snail topiary winds its way into your heart with its spiraling shell and whimsical vibe. Perfect for those who know that good gardening, like all good snails, takes its time.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures4_43: Silent, sleek, and entirely green, this topiary panther stands with an air of leafy elegance. Its striking silhouette adds a wild edge to your garden while reminding everyone who the true king of the backyard jungle is.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures4_50: Weathered by time and warmed by countless pie crusts, Samy's Cottage Counter brings the charm of a countryside kitchen into your home. With chipped paint and heart, it tells a story of flour-dusted mornings and secret family recipes.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures4_7: Standing tall and wise, this carved wooden owl doesn't just decorate your space: it supervises it. With its piercing gaze and detailed plumage, it brings an air of natural elegance to any cozy cabin.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_10: Reach new heights in outdoor decor with this towering topiary! Lovingly sculpted from lush green hedge, the Garden Giraffe is a majestic addition to any lawn or garden. Tall, elegant, its graceful neck and leafy spots will bring a safari vibe to your home.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_11: Hop into a world of whimsy with this leafy amphibian friend! Meticulously sculpted from a hedge block, the Garden Frog brings charm and a touch of nature to any outdoor space. Whether it’s perched by a pond or sitting proudly in your flower bed, this froggy masterpiece is sure to make your garden ribbit with delight.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_38: Tick-tock your way to classic elegance with this handcrafted wooden pendulum clock. Standing tall and stately, the Grandfather Clock is more than just a timepiece, it's a statement of tradition and craftsmanship. Its steady chime brings an air of sophistication to any room, while its intricate details speak of careful handiwork.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_54: Freeze! This poor fellow made the ultimate mistake by locking eyes with the wrong lady. Now immortalized in stone (literally), he’s the perfect piece to add a touch of mythological mischief to your decor. Sculpted with stunning detail, the Medusa Victim is a real rock star in the art world. Place him in your garden or foyer and let his tale of woe spark conversation... or maybe just caution.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_55: Who needs a real butler when you can have this rust-worthy gent? Crafted from repurposed scrap metal, the Robo Butler stands ready to serve… at least in spirit. With a charmingly dapper demeanor, he's the perfect mix of industrial chic and quirky charm. Ideal for your foyer, study, or anywhere that could use a touch of robotic refinement.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_6: Bring a touch of playful greenery to your garden with this quirky bush! Shaped like a sprightly plant ready to defend its patch, the Little Peashooter adds charm and a hint of determination to any outdoor space.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_62: Blast off... or maybe just rust off! This pile of scrap may not reach the stars, but it’ll definitely make your decor shine. Lovingly pieced together from the finest rusty bits, the T-Rusty Rocket brings a touch of cosmic charm and industrial grit to your backyard. Perfect for aspiring astronauts or junkyard enthusiasts alike!
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_8: Command the spirit of the islands with this towering wooden masterpiece! The Tiki Lord brings exotic vibes and a touch of mystery to any space, indoors or out. Hand-carved with intricate details and a fierce expression, this statue is perfect to set the vibe at your backyard luau or to add an exotic flair to your living room.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_9: For those who demands nothing less than regal relief! This majestic sculpture combines the splendor of a royal throne with the... practicality of a toilet. Carved from the finest stone (or so they say), it's a cheeky addition to any garden or gallery. The Porcelain Throne reminds us all that even kings and queens need their quiet moments. Sit down, relax, and rule your kingdom in style!
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_Seating_: Why sit in the ordinary when you can perch upon a mechanical marvel? This unique chair, welded together from an assortment of aged and rusted scrap, boasts a design that's part seat, part statement, featuring riveted armrests and a backrest that could double as a gearhead's dream.
Lounge in a work of art with this handcrafted chair that brings flowing curves and organic patterns straight from the best art movement straight into your space.
Tooltip_Sculpting_LS_Sculptures_lighting: A little rusty, a lot brilliant: this steampunk-inspired lamp turns salvage into style. Standing tall with a patchwork of gears, pipes, and other salvaged scraps, it casts a warm, industrial glow perfect for late-night tinkering or plotting your next great invention.

Why settle for an ordinary end table when you could have a masterpiece of functional ingenuity? This compact creation fuses salvaged metalwork with a built-in light, making it equal parts table, lamp and a conversation starter. Great for late-night reading, blueprint drafting, or just showing off your flair for industrial chic.

STATION 9 - COMPILED DOSSIER <LINE> <LINE> The shift logs chronicle Station 9's final days of operation. <LINE> Chief Martinez organized an emergency supply cache before the <LINE> crew was forced to abandon the station. The compiled documents <LINE> include a sketch of the cache location with the note: <LINE> 'TURNOUT GEAR AND TOOLS - BREAK GLASS IN CASE OF APOCALYPSE.'
Tooltip_DMD_FirefighterPage1: KNOX COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT <LINE> STATION 9 - SHIFT LOG <LINE> <LINE> Multiple structure fires reported across the county. All units <LINE> deployed. Engine 9 responded to a warehouse blaze on Industrial <LINE> Ave - found the building barricaded from inside. Screaming from <LINE> upper floors. Attempted rescue. Lost contact with Firefighter <LINE> Kowalski on the second floor. Chief ordered full withdrawal.
Tooltip_DMD_FirefighterPage2: KNOX COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT (CONT.) <LINE> STATION 9 - SHIFT LOG <LINE> <LINE> Station 9 is now our last holdout. Chief Martinez stashed our <LINE> remaining gear - axes, helmets, protective equipment - in the <LINE> emergency cache behind the station before things got bad. The <LINE> combination is on the whiteboard in the break room. If you're <LINE> reading this and the station is empty, check the cache. Stay safe.
Tooltip_DMD_MedicalComplete: HOSPITAL INCIDENT FILE - COMPILED DOSSIER <LINE> <LINE> The assembled reports reveal the hospital was ground zero for <LINE> the Knox County outbreak. Dr. Patel had the foresight to cache <LINE> critical medical supplies before the facility was overrun. <LINE> A hand-drawn map on the last page shows the basement storage <LINE> location, marked with a red cross and the note: 'FOR SURVIVORS.'
Tooltip_DMD_MedicalPage1: KNOX COUNTY GENERAL HOSPITAL <LINE> INCIDENT REPORT - CONFIDENTIAL <LINE> <LINE> Patient zero presented with high fever and severe bite wound <LINE> on the forearm. Within 6 hours, vital signs flatlined. Staff <LINE> pronounced death at 1847H. Body was moved to cold storage. <LINE> At 2015H, morgue attendant reported 'movement' from the unit. <LINE> Security dispatched. No further update from that team.
Tooltip_DMD_MedicalPage2: KNOX COUNTY GENERAL HOSPITAL (CONT.) <LINE> INCIDENT REPORT - CONFIDENTIAL <LINE> <LINE> Quarantine wing is now sealed. Dr. Patel ordered all remaining <LINE> antibiotics and surgical supplies moved to the basement lockup <LINE> before the military cordon cut us off. The emergency supply <LINE> manifest is taped inside the drug cabinet in Storage Room B. <LINE> If anyone finds this - the supplies are still down there.
Tooltip_DMD_MilitaryComplete: OPERATION DEADBOLT - COMPILED DOSSIER <LINE> <LINE> The full after-action report tells the story of a military <LINE> operation that went catastrophically wrong. Firebase Echo fell <LINE> in under 24 hours. But buried in the logistics section is a <LINE> set of GPS coordinates for a supply cache, circled twice and <LINE> annotated: 'LAST RESORT - HEAVY GEAR STASHED HERE.'
Tooltip_DMD_MilitaryPage1: CLASSIFIED - OPERATION DEADBOLT <LINE> AFTER-ACTION REPORT (1 of 3) <LINE> <LINE> 0600H: Firebase Echo established perimeter along Route 7. <LINE> Initial contact with hostile elements at 0847H. Rules of <LINE> engagement proved ineffective - targets did not respond to <LINE> warning shots or non-lethal deterrents. Ammunition expenditure <LINE> exceeded projections by 400%% within the first hour.
Tooltip_DMD_MilitaryPage2: CLASSIFIED - OPERATION DEADBOLT (CONT.) <LINE> AFTER-ACTION REPORT (2 of 3) <LINE> <LINE> 1400H: Field hospital at Grid Ref 7742 was overrun. Medical <LINE> staff casualties total. Pvt. Chen's squad attempted extraction <LINE> but was cut off at the bridge. Requesting immediate air support <LINE> - denied due to 'airspace restrictions.' Command is not <LINE> responding to priority channels. We are on our own out here.
Tooltip_DMD_MilitaryPage3: CLASSIFIED - OPERATION DEADBOLT (CONT.) <LINE> AFTER-ACTION REPORT (3 of 3) <LINE> <LINE> 2200H: Evacuation order rescinded. Repeat - evacuation CANCELED. <LINE> Remaining personnel ordered to fall back to secondary positions <LINE> and secure all supply caches. Sgt. Torres cached heavy ordnance <LINE> at a fallback position before comms went dead. GPS coordinates <LINE> are logged in the field command notebook. God help us all.
Tooltip_DMD_PoliceComplete: KNOX COUNTY PD - COMPILED DOSSIER <LINE> <LINE> All pages assembled. The documents paint a grim picture: <LINE> Checkpoint 7 fell within hours of first contact. The <LINE> quarantine wing was overrun before evacuation orders came. <LINE> Someone circled a location on the attached map in red ink <LINE> and scrawled 'SUPPLY CACHE - GET THERE FIRST' in the margin.
Tooltip_DMD_PolicePage1: INTERNAL MEMO - KNOX COUNTY PD <LINE> <LINE> TO: All Units <LINE> RE: Checkpoint 7 Status <LINE> <LINE> Checkpoint 7 went dark at 0300 hours. No response on <LINE> any frequency. Last transmission was Officer Briggs <LINE> reporting 'movement in the treeline' before the line <LINE> cut. Dispatch is reclassifying this as a Code Black. <LINE> Do NOT approach without backup. Await further orders.
Tooltip_DMD_PolicePage2: INTERNAL MEMO - KNOX COUNTY PD (CONT.) <LINE> <LINE> Media blackout is now in full effect per state order. <LINE> Any officer found communicating details of the quarantine <LINE> wing or Checkpoint 7 incident to civilians will face <LINE> immediate suspension. Evidence lockup at the West Point <LINE> precinct has been designated as a secondary supply cache. <LINE> Coordinates are on file. Access code taped under the desk.
Tooltip_DMD_RangerComplete: RANGER STATION 4 - COMPILED DOSSIER <LINE> <LINE> Two field reports from Ranger Station 4 tell the story of the <LINE> outbreak spreading through the wilderness. The rangers cached <LINE> hunting and survival equipment before abandoning their post. <LINE> The final page includes GPS coordinates to the supply cache, <LINE> underlined three times with the note: 'LAST CHANCE - GEAR UP.'
Tooltip_DMD_RangerPage1: KNOX COUNTY PARKS & WILDLIFE <LINE> FIELD REPORT - RANGER STATION 4 <LINE> <LINE> Something is wrong with the wildlife. Found three deer carcasses <LINE> near Miller's Creek - partially consumed, bite patterns inconsistent <LINE> with any known predator. Radio contact with Station 2 lost two <LINE> days ago. Hikers on the Appalachian Trail section are not checking <LINE> in at waypoints. Closing all trails effective immediately.
Tooltip_DMD_RangerPage2: KNOX COUNTY PARKS & WILDLIFE (CONT.) <LINE> FIELD REPORT - RANGER STATION 4 <LINE> <LINE> Ranger Davis and I made a supply run to the hunting lodge off <LINE> Route 12. Stashed rifles, ammunition, and camping equipment in <LINE> the underground cellar. Combination lock - code is Davis's badge <LINE> number backwards. <LINE> <LINE> This is my last entry. Tooltip_WaterFilterCartridge: A replaceable charcoal-and-cloth filter for a Filter Water Purifier. Right-click the purifier to install it and restore its purifying charges.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeDesc: Carries water or fuel. Auto-connects into a network. Plumb sinks, showers and toilets; link barrels, rain collectors and vessels. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeDripDesc: Drip emitter. A pipe that waters the crop on its own tile and passes water on. No pressure needed, only water. Too much pressure bursts it, so keep pumps off its line or cap it with a router. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeHiddenDesc: A pipe plastered out of sight. Carries fluid like a normal one. Reveal it with 'Show pipe network'. Needs a Pipe Wrench and a bucket of mixed cement.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRiserDesc: A pipe run up a wall. Links floor pipes on both sides and connects different floors. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRiserHiddenDesc: A vertical pipe plastered into the wall. Links floors out of sight. Reveal it with 'Show pipe network'. Needs a Pipe Wrench and a bucket of mixed cement.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRouterDesc: A one-way valve: water flows in through the green band (IN) and out through the red band (OUT), never back, capped at the pressure ceiling you set. Put a vessel on its tile and the two sides exchange only through it: a purifier cleans water in transit, a tank buffers it. Rotate with R to aim the OUT side.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeSprinklerDesc: Sprinkler. A pipe that waters the whole 3x3 around it, but needs real pressure, which means a pump. It sprays every tile whether or not it is growing, wastes water, and is loud enough to draw zombies. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPressureGaugeDesc: Pressure dial. Sits on a pipe; right-click to read the pressure at that point and whether a sprinkler would run there. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPumpDesc: Electric pump. On a pipe run it raises pressure while powered, and chained pumps add up. Beside a well or open water it also draws water into the network. It sucks up from about two floors below but pushes far higher, so place it low. Needs a Pipe Wrench and welding gear.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPurifierElectricDesc: Electric purifier tank. Put it on a Fluid Router: tainted water enters from the green (IN) side and leaves purified through the red (OUT) side while it has power. The filter wears with use; right-click to repair it with charcoal and ripped sheets. Needs welding gear and clear space above.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPurifierFilterDesc: A charcoal-filter water tank. Place it on a Fluid Router: water crossing the router (IN->OUT) comes out clean while the tank holds a working filter cartridge. Right-click to replace the cartridge. Most useful with the 'Realistic water purification' sandbox option ON.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPurifierFireDesc: A fire-still water tank. Place it on a Fluid Router: water crossing (IN->OUT) is purified while a lit heat source (campfire, stove, brazier...) sits right next to it. No cartridges to refill. Most useful with 'Realistic water purification' ON.

Tooltip_GS_Motherboard: Holds every other part of the computer together and never gets a thank you.

Tooltip_GSEPC_FieldGrade: Old grade. Repair effectiveness: 70%% of Regular. Each part provides about 35 condition-equivalent repair instead of the normal 50. Requires Mechanics 6, Metalworking 4 and Electrical 4.
Tooltip_GSEPC_ServiceGrade: Regular grade. Repair effectiveness: 100%% baseline. Each part provides the normal 50 condition-equivalent repair. Requires Mechanics 7, Metalworking 5 and Electrical 4.
Tooltip_GSEPC_Reconditioned: Performance grade. Repair effectiveness: 140%% of Regular. Each part provides about 70 condition-equivalent repair instead of the normal 50. Requires Mechanics 8, Metalworking 5 and Electrical 4.
Tooltip_GS_Manual_NetworkDisk_DiskProgra: "GS Disk Tools": step-by-step instructions for writing the disk that carries the GS network's own operating system. Requires standing close enough to a terminal to bother.
Tooltip_GS_Manual_SolderingIron: A scrappy DIY guide to building your own soldering iron out of scavenged parts. Reading it alone won't get you anywhere - somebody has to actually allow this shortcut first.
Tooltip_craft_TCAppearanceStationDesc: A mirror and a pair of scissors. Bring a companion here to rename them and change their hair, beard and hair colour.
Tooltip_craft_TCSurvivorBeaconDesc: A radio post that tells other survivors your base is open. Must be built against a wall. Place one, set your base area, and people will start finding their way to you.
Tooltip_CorpseBurn_ZombiePartsBundle:
A whole zombie's parts - one torso, two arms, two legs -
tied into a single bundle at half the weight of the loose parts.
Burns for up to 2 hours in a campfire when fresh,
and is only as fresh as its oldest part.
Keeps rotting like meat - refrigeration slows the rot.
Left on the ground, it crumbles away a few days after rotting completely.
Double-click in your inventory to untie.
Tooltip_item_RR_ModelManual_GP7:
The builder's operating manual for one class of locomotive:
controls, starting, running, what to do when she will not.
Read it and you can run a GP7 light engine.
Tooltip_item_RR_TrainHandlingBook:
The company book: the automatic brake, slack, grades, signals.
The brake handle you already know stops the locomotive and
nothing else. A train is stopped down the brake pipe, and
getting that wrong is what runs a grade away from you.
Long enough to take several sittings.
Teaches working a train: couplers, and the brake that
reaches the cars.
Tooltip_Recipe_RR_Operate_GP7: You can start and drive a GP7 light engine.
Tooltip_Recipe_RR_TrainHandling: You can couple cars and handle a train on the automatic brake.

Tooltip_PR_KX13Ampoule: A sealed experimental antiviral ampoule. It guarantees removal of the zombie infection, but triggers a severe systemic reaction.
Tooltip_PR_KX13PrototypeAmpoule: The original KX-13 prototype. Guaranteed cure followed by a delayed, severe systemic reaction.
Tooltip_PR_KX13DamagedAmpoule: A weathered KX-13 ampoule with a damaged seal. Guaranteed cure, but the fastest and most dangerous reaction.
Tooltip_PR_KX13StabilizedAmpoule: A hospital-stabilized KX-13 formula. Guaranteed cure with substantially reduced damage and symptoms.
Tooltip_PR_KX13MilitaryAmpoule: A fast military KX-13 formula. Guaranteed cure with a short, concentrated systemic crisis.
Tooltip_PR_AlreadyTreating: The body is already processing a KX-13 dose.
Tooltip_PR_NotInfected: No zombie infection is detected. The ampoule will still be consumed and the full serum reaction will occur.
Tooltip_PR_InjectWarning: Cure is guaranteed. Prepare water, food, medicine and a secure place before injection.
Tooltip_PR_InjectPrototype: Standard prototype. The severe reaction develops gradually after a two-hour stabilization period.
Tooltip_PR_InjectDamaged: Damaged seal. The reaction begins quickly, lasts longer and can push the body close to collapse.
Tooltip_PR_InjectStabilized: Hospital formula. Direct damage and systemic symptoms are substantially reduced.
Tooltip_PR_InjectMilitary: Military formula. The total reaction is compressed into a shorter and more violent crisis.
Tooltip_LGMainsWater_Plumb: Connects it to the building's own water supply, exactly as the fixtures the building came with are connected. It has water whenever they do.
